result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major invalid delivery-price value and one minor text clipping issue in the horizontal restaurant list.

issues.description: The "Smash Bros Burgers" card displays "€NaN delivery", exposing an invalid/uncomputed price instead of a usable delivery fee.
issues.suggestion: Validate and format delivery-fee data before rendering. Show the correct price, "Free delivery", or a deliberate fallback such as "Delivery fee unavailable" if no value exists.

issues.description: The third item in the "Fastest near you" horizontal list is cut off at the right edge, including its restaurant name, making the content appear truncated.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel has clear intentional overflow behavior, such as adequate end padding, a partial-next-card affordance, or a visible scroll indicator; avoid clipping text in a way that looks accidental.
